chain.label: Unrecognized tailwind on runway 30
chain.trigger: the instantaneous wind 12 seconds before landing was 195° at 17 knots, which would have resulted in a 5.6-knot tailwind

caused_by.evidence: the CVR did not record either pilot verbally monitoring the wind information
AWOS observations...indicated wind shifts from the north to the south...during the 10 minutes before the accident

chain.label: Wet, ungrooved runway with reduced braking friction
chain.trigger: the runway surface was wet...the friction available on the wet runway was only about 20 to 30 percent of that available on a dry runway

caused_by.evidence: AWOS reported winds 170° at 6 knots, visibility 10 miles in moderate rain

chain.label: Continued landing on runway 30 without reassessing tailwind/wet conditions
chain.trigger: evidence indicates that the pilots did not consider these factors or reassess the landing situation

caused_by.evidence: he did not properly account for the tailwind and consequent higher ground speed at touchdown
no evidence indicates that the captain was prepared for the possibility of a go-around

chain.label: Delayed/partial lift-dump deployment after touchdown
chain.trigger: the captain only moved the airbrake handle to the OPEN position instead of fully aft to the DUMP position and likely did not fully deploy the lift-dump system...until about 7 seconds after touchdown

caused_by.evidence: the captain likely applied sufficient pressure on the brakes...but failed to immediately deploy the lift-dump system after touchdown

chain.label: Delayed decision to attempt a go-around late in the landing roll
chain.trigger: the probable cause of this accident was the captain's decision to attempt a go-around late in the landing roll with insufficient runway remaining

caused_by.evidence: the deceleration rate was such that the airplane would have exited the runway end...it can be reasonably assumed that the captain likely became concerned that the airplane would run off the runway end

chain.label: Go-around executed with flaps improperly configured
chain.trigger: postaccident examination of the flaps indicated that they were fully retracted (that is, set at 0°), not set to 15° as required for a go-around

caused_by.evidence: the captain's use of incorrect terminology...at 0945:22 was part of a go-around attempt

chain.label: Airplane ran off runway end and became airborne
chain.trigger: the airplane ran off the runway end at 0945:29 and lifted off the ground at 0945:34, about 978 feet from the runway end

caused_by.evidence: takeoff calculations...indicated that...the airplane could not have rotated and lifted off before the runway end with the flaps set at either 15° or 0°

chain.label: Collision with localizer antenna support structure

caused_by.evidence: the airplane...impacted the ILS localizer antenna about 5 feet agl

chain.label: Ground impact in cornfield beyond airport
chain.trigger: the airplane...eventually came to rest in a cornfield beyond a dirt access road that borders the airport, which was about 2,136 feet from the runway end

caused_by.evidence: the airplane then continued to roll to the right and descend, impacting the ground

chain.label: Fatal injuries to all occupants
chain.trigger: the two pilots and six passengers were killed, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces
